episodes.title: Unstable
episodes.summary: Reeling from a tragedy, Ellis struggles to focus at work as a major project looms, forcing Anna to reach out to Ellis' son Jackson for help.

episodes.title: Engaged, Focused and Ridiculously Sane
episodes.summary: After an odd discovery in Ellis' basement, Jackson stays longer in LA and sets boundaries with his dad — which inspires Ellis to stand up to the board.

episodes.title: The Wizard of Odd
episodes.summary: Determined to change the narrative of his life and business, Ellis invites a reporter to shadow him, while Anna tries to make things seem normal at work.

episodes.title: Pilgrims and Sex Parties
episodes.summary: Facing fallout from the Time cover, Ellis fears getting ousted and receives support from an old pal, while Anna uncovers intel to keep the twins at bay.

episodes.title: Beautiful Birthday Bastards
episodes.summary: When the twins threaten to press charges, Anna and Ellis plan a birthday surprise. Jackson and the Red Lab crew head to the bar, where feelings emerge.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Eduardo
episodes.summary: A call from an old professor puts Jackson in a tough spot. The Red Lab crew faces hard truths. Ellis sets his sights on new heights at his side job.

episodes.title: Roasting For Beginners
episodes.summary: Ellis and Jackson spend the day doing landscaping work until the father-son bonding time turns into a roast. At the house, Leslie wears out his welcome.

episodes.title: A Dragon's Fire
episodes.summary: An emergency board meeting puts Ellis' job on the line. A shocking discovery forces Jackson to step up to save the company — and his dad — from disaster.

episodes.title: Shanked
episodes.summary: Ellis prepares to pay the price for his fiery behavior while Anna pushes for fresh leadership at the company. Jackson makes a new friend — and a bold move.

episodes.title: Winning Time
episodes.summary: Ellis experiences an odd side effect after undergoing a reverse-aging treatment. Georgia stirs up drama in the lab by spreading rumors about the merger.

episodes.title: Retreat
episodes.summary: As Ellis and Jackson bicker over their management styles, Dragon celebrates its growth with a company retreat that includes a couple of party crashers.

episodes.title: Mindhunter
episodes.summary: Ellis grows concerned after Jackson shares his unique scientific vision. A secret meeting puts pressure on Peter. Ruby gives career advice to Luna.

episodes.title: MOCAP Man
episodes.summary: With BioTexpo approaching, Ellis tries to get Jackson into a motion capture suit. Georgia dabbles in manipulation, and Ruby receives a tempting offer.

episodes.title: Dragon Slayer
episodes.summary: Ellis and Peter sit down for a joint interview. Threatening messages arrive at Dragon, leading to an in-house investigation — and plenty of suspects.

episodes.title: Ron Tabasco
episodes.summary: A real estate convention turns out to be the perfect escape for Ellis and Jackson. Anna enlists Peter's help ahead of an important meeting.

episodes.title: Ellis U
episodes.summary: Driven by the developments at Dragon, Ellis launches a new scheme that causes issues for the lab team as they rush to meet the bio-battery deadline.
